protocol.asOf: each market's last trading day of the month
protocol.composite: mean of available z; fewer than minSignals gives no label

computabilityCheck.belowKR: Korea leaves the v1 ratings; deep reports only
computabilityCheck.rule: eligible members with at least minSignals signals / eligible members; no company-specific exception codes

review.rule: a market whose 24-month mean primary metric <= 0 or mean IC <= 0 has its labels downgraded to '관찰 신호'; applied without a review

evaluation.baselineUse: reported only, never used for decisions
evaluation.calendar: dates traded by at least half of the market's price series that had started by then
evaluation.costs: buy rate x weight bought + sell rate x weight sold when rebalancing from the previous portfolio's drifted weights; the first period buys all
evaluation.entry: member's first close on or after the first session after the market-local registration date (a later close is flagged late_entry)
evaluation.exit: close on the next registration's entry session, or on the last session on or before the evaluation date; else the last close before it (last_price)
evaluation.missingEntry: excluded from the period with the reason, kept in the counts
evaluation.primary: 선호 equal-weight return - mean same-sector equal-weight return of eligible members, minus costs
secondary: Spearman IC of composite and return

financialExclusions.treatment: excluded members keep a row with the reason and no label and stay in the denominator

protocol.hysteresisRule: a previous 선호 stays 선호 at percentile >= hysteresis; a previous 회피 stays 회피 at percentile <= hysteresis

marketCap.KR: sum over listed share classes of listedShares x that class's unadjusted close at T; listedShares = Naver market cap / current price at registration; a class without its own price uses the common close (class_price_proxy)
marketCap.US: unadjusted close at T x shares (cover-page shares, else the latest quarterly diluted weighted-average shares as a flagged proxy)
marketCap.stalePrice: the last close on or before T is used and flagged stale_price

fundamentals.filedRule: usable filing date <= asOf - 1 day (US companyfacts filed; KR first 8 digits of rcept_no)

kr.capexCheck: previous same cumulative period above previous annual withholds capex
kr.fsRule: per report CFS then OFS; one fs_div for every report of the trailing year, OFS when the CFS previous annual is missing
kr.ttm: annual thstrm; else cumulative thstrm + previous annual thstrm - previous same cumulative period
kr.walkRule: newest report first; a period ending on or after asOf is not probed; a report filed on or after asOf is skipped

fundamentals.status: ok only when every REQUIRED field is present; otherwise insufficient with the available fields kept and the reasons in error

us.capexCheck: previous same-length YTD above previous annual withholds capex
us.capexTag: first tag reporting every period of the CFO trailing year
us.multiValueCover: sum (distinct classes) or largest (reported total) only when it agrees with a check count; otherwise not used
us.periodEnd: latest end among CFO durations and Assets instants; CFO and assets must both be reported at it
us.pointInTime: per (start, end) the latest usable filing
us.sharesRule: cover if it agrees with a check count (or none exists); diluted if cover is absent or both checks agree against it; otherwise withheld
us.ttm: annual at periodEnd; else YTD + previous annual - previous same-length YTD; else four contiguous reported quarters

KR.preferred: same first five code characters, last character not 0, name starting with the common name

US.issuer: SEC CIK via company_tickers.json (BRK.B -> BRK-B); one member per CIK, priced by the class with the largest SPY weight
US.sectors: Fama-French 12 from Siccodes12; SIC outside every range = Other

protocol.percentile: mean rank / n of the composite within the market, ascending, in (0, 1]

pointInTime.filings: filed strictly before asOf (US companyfacts filed date, KR receipt-number date); a record without filedAt is not used

registration.rule: market-local registration date strictly after asOf; a file is never overwritten; dry runs stay out of the ledger and the evaluation

sectors.US: SIC via Ken French's official definition file

signals.direction: higher is better for every signal

fcfYield.capex: acquisition of property, plant and equipment as a non-negative payment; negative or missing gives no value
fcfYield.currency: filing currency must equal the market currency
fcfYield.marketCap: missing or non-positive gives no value

momentum12_1.definition: adjclose[T-21] / adjclose[T-252] - 1 over the member's own sessions on or before T

signals.trailingTwelveMonths: annual value, else current cumulative + prior annual - prior-year same-period cumulative

KR.rule: KOSPI common stocks (code ending in 0) without SPACs and REITs, top 200 by market capitalisation; a rule, not the official KOSPI 200

US.rule: S&P 500 constituents in the SSGA SPY daily holdings file, one row per issuer (CIK); an issuer with several share classes is priced with the ticker of largest SPY weight

winsor.scope: per market and signal over eligible members with a value

zScore.fallback: market mean when the sector has fewer than minSectorSize values
zScore.scale: market population standard deviation of winsorized values

inputs.fundamentalsError: cfoTTM: no annual, year-to-date or four-quarter trailing year ends 2026-06-30 (us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities); capexTTM: no CFO trailing year to align with
shares: no cover or quarterly diluted share count

run.note: smoke test of the pipeline on a partial universe or collection; not a rating, never evaluated or reported
